description: Fase B baseline: the webview can talk to the app's own API/sockets (via CSP connect-src, not a capability) and use only Tauri's core defaults. No filesystem, shell, or hardware permission is granted here on purpose - see docs/architecture/ohnix-multiplatform-strategy.md §6 (default-deny model) and §17/Fase C for when printer/cash-drawer plugins actually need scoped permissions added.
